scripts.build: node scripts/generate-extension-config.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run bundle:content && npm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist && cp -r public dist/ && cp src/manifest.json dist/ && cp src/ui/*.html dist/ui/ && cp src/ui/*.css dist/ui/
scripts.watch: node scripts/generate-extension-config.mjs && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run bundle:content -- --watch"
